title: My Customers
subtitle: The organisations you run games for. Tag a game with a customer in the Playground (when launching it, or afterwards) to build their history.

list.empty: No customers yet. Create one here, import a list, or add one on the fly when launching a game in the Playground.

form.similarHint: Check it is not one of them before creating a duplicate.

detail.archivedBanner: This customer is archived: it is hidden from the Playground pickers, its history is kept.
detail.deleteHasGames: This customer has games and cannot be deleted. Archive it, or merge it into another customer.
detail.historyEmpty: No game tagged with this customer yet.
detail.notPlayedHint: Your scenarios this customer has never played - ideas for their next visit.
detail.notPlayedEmpty: This customer has played all your scenarios.
detail.notFound: This customer does not exist (any more).

merge.title: Merge "{{name}}"
merge.intro: All the games of "{{name}}" move to the customer you pick, and "{{name}}" disappears. Devices that still know it are redirected automatically.

attach.title: Attach past games to "{{name}}"
attach.search: Search a game name or scenario…

import.title: Import customers
import.intro: Choose an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file with one customer per row and a header row. Customers whose name already exists are skipped.
import.parseError: This file could not be read.
import.noName: Map a column to "Name" to continue.
